scope: Full bank; deterministic candidate detection, not a claim of complete semantic review

interpretation.same_options_and_answer: Same options and selected propositions after normalization; review stem conditions before disposition
interpretation.same_teaching_target: Same extracted teaching target in the legacy scaffold generator; not automatically an exact duplicate
interpretation.number_masked_stem: Same problem text after removing parameter values and generic company names
interpretation.cross_chapter_number_masked_stem: Candidate question text after masking numbers that appears across chapters
interpretation.cross_chapter_same_options_and_answer: Same normalized options and selected propositions across chapters; review context
interpretation.cross_chapter_same_numeric_inputs_and_an: Same displayed numbers, numeric answer and unit across chapters; coincidence is possible and requires review
